# Notices for the vendored WOFF2 decoder

`woff2-decompress.js` and `woff2-decompress.wasm` are generated by
`scripts/build-woff2-decoder.ts` from the npm package `woff2-encoder` 2.0.0,
which is google/woff2 (including Brotli) compiled to WebAssembly. All three are
under the MIT licence. Their notices follow.
